steps.python:
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time
folder = os.path.dirname(app.rpc.file)
info = json.load(open(app.rpc.file))
assert info['pid'] == os.getpid() and len(info['key']) == 64 and info['protocol'] == 'nuka.rpc.v1', info
out = r'${out}/rpc_client.json'
env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=os.pathsep.join(p for p in sys.path if p))
p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, r'${scenario_dir}/rpc_client.py', os.path.dirname(folder), str(os.getpid()), out], env=env)
deadline = time.monotonic() + 120.0
while p.poll() is None:
    assert time.monotonic() < deadline, 'the client still runs'
    app.update(True)
assert p.returncode == 0, p.returncode
r = json.load(open(out))
print('RPC', r)
assert r['listed'] == [os.getpid()], r
assert r['hello']['client'] == 'smoke' and r['hello']['document']['path'].endswith('stage.nks'), r
assert r['actions'] > 200 and r['has_spawn'] and r['revised'] and r['source'] == 'agent:smoke', r
assert 'no.such_action' in r['bad_action'] and 'no_such_op' in r['bad_op'] and 'missing' in r['missing_arg'], r
assert r['shot']['width'] > 0 and r['shot']['height'] > 0 and r['shot']['png'] > 1000, r
assert r['wait'] and r['console'] and r['crossed'] == 0 and r['bad_key'] == 'refused', r
deadline = time.monotonic() + 10.0
while app.rpc.sessions():
    assert time.monotonic() < deadline, app.rpc.sessions()
    app.update(True)
log = [e for e in app.actions.log(0) if e['source'].startswith('agent:')]
assert {e['source'] for e in log} >= {'agent:smoke', 'agent:smoke-tick'}, log[-3:]

import os
f = app.rpc.file
app.rpc.close()
assert not os.path.exists(f), f
